title: VizualChat
description: The plugin modifies the chat, changing its design. It includes anti-spam (a 5-second delay between messages) and anti-swear filters, which can be enabled or disabled.
body:
VizualChat - Clean & Protected Minecraft Chat
VizualChat is a lightweight server plugin designed to enhance the default Minecraft chat experience by improving its visual clarity and adding essential moderation tools.

✨ Key Features:

Clean Visual Overhaul: Removes the static gray chat background ("frame"), leaving only clean text on the screen for a more immersive look.

Eye-Friendly Text: Changes the default bright white chat text to a softer, light gray color, reducing eye strain during long gaming sessions.

Spam Protection: Automatically blocks users from sending the same message repeatedly. Spammers get a 5-second chat cooldown.

Smart Swear Filter: Automatically detects and censors swear words by replacing them with asterisks (****). Can be toggled on/off by admins in-game via /chatik.

🚀 Why Choose VizualChat?

Instant Improvement: Works immediately after installation, no complex setup needed.

Server-Friendly: Lightweight with minimal performance impact.

Better for Players: Creates a calmer, more readable, and less toxic chat environment for your community.
